sources.title: Beyond Ternary OPV: High-Throughput Experimentation and Self-Driving Laboratories Optimize Multicomponent Systems
sources.status: peer-reviewed journal article; published online 2020-02-12; April 2020 issue
sources.verified: Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata, author abstract, original authors' repository README and pinned numeric workbook. Primary publisher main-article text was independently inspected: workflow (18 h one-sun ambient-air exposure), Figure 2 caption (relative absorbance loss and weight fractions), SDA section (donor:acceptor range and paired specimens) and experimental-method source locators.
sources.supports: Measured photostability of quaternary organic photovoltaic blends and high-throughput/autonomous experimentation. The original repository separates measured workbook values from pre-existing emulator predictions. It supplies the measured data reanalyzed in the present study.
sources.does_not_support: The study does not establish carryover in this workbook, chronological meaning for Sample 1/2 labels, a physical Lipschitz upper bound, the proposed noise law or validation of the confirmation planner. Its article license is not automatically a license for the separate repository workbook.
sources.relevance: Primary materials dataset and response semantics; derived analyses remain distinct from original authors' experiments.
sources.access_limits: Main-article relevant text inspected directly using the primary /doi/ endpoint. The /doi/full/ endpoint was unavailable. Supporting-information Table S1, Figure S4 and section S1 were previously inspected by the live_demo/data reviewer; a second independent SI retrieval was blocked. Original numeric workbook independently checked. No claim of reproducing the original authors' neural-network models.
sources.publication_status_check: Current Crossref record identifies a journal article; inspected record has no update relation. This is not an exhaustive retraction or correction search.

sources.title: Extension of range of functions
sources.journal: Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society
sources.verified: Bibliographic identity and DOI cross-checked against AMS bibliographic listings and indexing records; attempted original AMS article/PDF fetch returned 403 and Project Euclid was blocked by a security page.
sources.supports: Historical attribution for the extension of real-valued Lipschitz functions. The present finite-data upper/lower cone envelope is proved directly in Appendix A and theory_note.md.
sources.does_not_support: No uninspected theorem number, exact quotation, empirical result or novelty claim is attributed to this source. This paper is not evidence about physical carryover or materials data.
sources.relevance: Foundational attribution; prevents portraying the classical Lipschitz extension principle as a new theorem.
sources.access_limits: Metadata verified; original mathematical text not inspected in this environment. Citation support for historical attribution is qualified by that access limit; the present mathematical proof has independent method verification.
sources.publication_status_check: Historical journal identity verified; no comprehensive correction/retraction database search performed.

sources.title: Simple and honest confidence intervals in nonparametric regression
sources.verified: Primary publisher metadata, abstract, introduction and general-results discussion inspected. Section 2 explains confidence intervals that account for a bound on estimator bias and explicitly specified smoothness restrictions.
sources.supports: Bias-aware confidence intervals and explicit smoothness assumptions have established statistical precedent. Merely estimating a favorable smoothness constant does not automatically preserve uniform coverage.
sources.does_not_support: It is not the source of the present carryover-specific recurrence, finite-menu planner or fixed-final additive-bias interval. It does not validate the physical values of L, retained fraction or sensor noise. Its more refined critical-value construction is not claimed to be implemented here.
sources.relevance: Prior statistical context for conservative bias-aware uncertainty and a limit on novelty claims.
sources.access_limits: Relevant publisher full-text introduction and Section 2 inspected; no claim that all appendices or supplemental programs were reproduced.
sources.publication_status_check: Publisher currently presents the paper as an original journal article; no exhaustive correction or retraction search performed.
